title: This channel might be gone soon (UNDER JAPANESE ATTACK)
summary: A channel update: the Japanese company that owns the Grappler Baki rights keeps blocking his videos and stalling his counter-claims with fresh claims. He refuses to fold, will accept strikes one at a time to force them to take legal action, and warns that the channel could be deleted.
claims: The Japanese rights holder of Grappler Baki blocked many of his videos and answers each counter-claim at the deadline with a new claim, abusing YouTube's copyright system
He considers his anime videos transformative and protected by fair use
With month-long waits per claim, recovering all his videos could take 5-6 years
He refuses to fold because he hates censorship, and the channel was already wrongly terminated once and restored by his viewers' support
Anime and manga are the reason he started the channel, as much a passion as lifting and philosophy
If he backs down now he'll back down for the rest of his life; he refuses to let demoralization stop him
He will take strikes one at a time and contest them so the company must show legal action, accepting the channel could be wiped
If he lets fear dictate his actions he'll make bad videos
